source._comment: No public SoS feed (sos.wv.gov election-data pages are historical only; early-voting news is prose press releases, statewide totals only; checked 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-22). The AbsenteeBallotTracking app is a per-voter lookup. Stand-in: the UF Election Lab's WV_county.csv, sourced from the WV Secretary of State (first posted 2026-10-22, all 55 counties, in-person early voters by party). If the SoS starts posting a county report (past generals: 'General Early Vote Turnout Report'), wire it in wv_update.fetch_counties().

_lab_no_requests: The Lab's WV note: no mail-ballot figure is published and its 'ballots requested' columns equal the early-vote returns, so requests / outstanding aren't shown.
